en: The Shādhilī Rifā’ī Qādirī Ṣūfī Ṭarīqah

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلىَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِۨ النُّوْرِ وَ أٰلِهٖ
blocks.review: After مُحَمَّدِ a small nūn quṭnī with kasra is printed low in the gap before النُّوْرِ; encoded as U+06E8 (small high nūn). عَلىَ printed with a plain fatḥa over the final letter, no dagger alif. Proof-reader: reading confirmed (small nūn below the gap carries its own kasra; standing kasra under hā of أٰلِهٖ); only the U+06E8 encoding choice for the low nūn quṭnī remains a convention question.
